LITTLE ROCK, Arkansas, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **Dillard’s, Inc.** **(“Dillard’s”)** (TXSE: DDS) is pleased to announce the launch of **Hadley Greene x Gianni Bini** , an exclusive, limited-edition fashion collaboration. The collection is available starting today in all Dillard’s stores nationwide and online at[dillards.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=m6CU4eUf59ceWq5cSvQ5gxKMolSMIeZ5-ewJ0lun-GqqY231HkMr5OUmLye6f_tLz3ZX0FKcXM40VYzA-00-mQ==) beginning at 10:00 a.m. CT.


Born in Texas and raised in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, Hadley Greene is a Los Angeles–based jewelry designer and tastemaker known for her distinct maximalist aesthetic, thoughtful wardrobe curation, and personal style commentary.


“I have fond memories of shopping **Dillard’s** growing up,” says Greene. “I designed **Hadley Greene x Gianni Bini** as an ode to my Louisiana heritage and the ease of Los Angeles - the two places that have shaped my sense of creativity and inspiration. We poured an incredible amount of thought and intentionality into every single piece, and everything in the collection has a special, thoughtful backstory.”


A jewelry designer, tastemaker, and storyteller, Hadley is known for a style that strikes the perfect balance between maximalist and timeless, with a one-of-a-kind eye for pieces that feel collected, personal, and enduring. **Hadley Greene** treats clothing as armor, the first thing you say before you’ve said a word. This collection is that instinct made wearable: expressive, storied, and unmistakably hers.


“We love Hadley’s Baton Rouge roots and her early connection to **Dillard’s** ,” adds Alexandra Dillard Lucie, Vice President of Merchandising. “She brings it all home for our **Gianni Bini** customer with gorgeous, unique pieces that are sure to inspire head-turning style for every occasion.”


The **Hadley Greene x Gianni Bini** capsule collection features statement jackets paired with bold separates, dresses, and footwear.

**About Hadley Greene**
Born in Texas and raised in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, **Hadley Greene** is a Los Angeles–based jewelry designer and tastemaker. A USC graduate with a degree in Art and Design, she seamlessly blends her passion for effortless expression with a bold, maximalist aesthetic that celebrates individuality. Drawing inspiration from patterns, textures, and unexpected combinations, Hadley crafts jewelry, fashion, and interior designs that are as ornamental as they are authentic. A trailblazer in the fashion and jewelry world, Hadley believes that great design should spark conversation, challenge norms, and inspire creativity. Her work tells an ongoing story of self-expression, where every piece invites a deeper connection with its wearer.


**About Gianni Bini**
**Gianni Bini,** Dillard's largest ladies' contemporary brand, was launched in 2001 in footwear and later extended to apparel. The mission of **Gianni Bini** is to remain at the forefront of fashion, offering designs that exude high quality and satisfy the contemporary customer's constant craving for innovation and trend-forward style. Each season, **Gianni Bini** delivers fresh yet timeless pieces that speak to every facet of the modern woman's life.
